Treasure reference no. 2010 T200: A large and complete silver Roman finger ring of Henig Type XI, inscribed TOT. The bezel is broad, rectangular and as a shallow channel running above and below. The bezel is decorated with an incised rectangle with diagonal grooves running around the perimeter. In the centre are the letters TOT, which is an abbreviation for the Celtic god-name Toutatis.
